protocolCoverage: Strict message shapes, bounded monotonic sequence IDs, session/client/binding validation and forbidden command rejection
Actual native BroadcastChannel structured clone of all three typed pixel buffers
Five supported airframes and valid dotted vehicle IDs; unknown vehicle binding rejection
One active operator, 500ms host capture rate gate, one pending frame and gimbal command
Pending frame and acknowledgement dropped on rebind, timeout, close or expired owner
No automatic resend of unknown gimbal outcomes; unrelated successful images do not erase unknown outcomes
Heartbeat loss retains explicitly stale image and requires rebinding; explicit close clears timers/channels permanently
Canonical gimbal settings and bounded actual telemetry validated before accepting a context
workerCoverage: Canonical operatorGimbal source event, explicit vehicle identity and independent controlled aircraft
Frozen inspection/NIST lease and hard event/byte cap rejection without running/lease/state mutation
All gimbal epochs, same-tick exposure event order, strict record18 parsing and native replay mappings
Real thirty-minute 360000-step, 96MiB and ten-minute NIST capacity gates retained in the full suite

regressionFix: Fresh-checkout NIST file verifier test now uses the existing project-local temporary-directory helper; no pre-created local/tests directory is required.
limits: Same origin/profile/storage partition only; cross-device/network operator service remains absent.
One operator per host session, built-in simulation only; no native SITL sensor-operator control.
Protocol is a convenience boundary, not authentication or a security isolation barrier.
Preview retains only the latest frame; export creates a single-frame dataset. No recorded video stream or remote persistence.
Background execution and loss handling depend on browser scheduling and are not hard real-time or hardware verified.
Recordings1-17 are rejected; no legacy compatibility adapter.
Market-wide civilian and military simulator capability objective remains incomplete.
